thread:
Raj Patel: noticing a spike of internal 5xx/timeout errors between model-api pods in eu-west-1 since ~09:10, looks like DNS/name resolution failures in the stack
Kelsey Nguyen: saw that too, traces show most failures are 'lookup redis.internal.svc.cluster.local: i/o timeout' from the client side
Mia Chen: quick check — coreDNS CPU/memory in the cluster look fine, but node-local-dns DaemonSet logs show occasional "read udp 10.2.1.3:50974->10.3.0.10:53: i/o timeout"
Sam Ortiz: can someone run a dig from affected node and from pod? want to see if node-local cache is timing out to CoreDNS upstream or if packets are dropped on path
Raj Patel: ran these on node and in a test pod:
```
# on node (hostNetwork nodelocaldns)
$ dig @169.254.20.10 redis.internal.svc.cluster.local +time=2
; -> timeout
# from pod
$ dig @10.96.0.10 redis.internal.svc.cluster.local +time=2
; -> timeout
```
Kelsey Nguyen: tcpdump (host) shows DNS requests leaving node-local cache to CoreDNS IP but no reply packets sometimes. noticed many fragmented UDP packets on the wire around the same times
Mia Chen: interesting — we have a mix of RDMA-enabled instances for GPU hosts with MTU 9000 and regular instances MTU 1500. suspect path MTU mismatch for intra-node control plane traffic hitting some gateway/hop that doesn't support jumbo frames
Sam Ortiz: Iperf between nodes?
Raj Patel: ran quick checks:
```
$ ping -s 1472 core-dns-host -c 3
From x.x.x.x: Frag needed and DF set (mtu = 1500)
```
infra-bot: deploy-watch: restarted node-local-dns on node i-0a1b2c due to OOMKill at 2026-03-16T09:35:12Z
Kelsey Nguyen: coreDNS logs show occasional "servfail" under batches of queries coming from node-local caches — probably caused by dropped UDP fragments; when response >512 bytes EDNS0 causes fragmentation
Mia Chen: temporary mitigation: set CoreDNS upstream to force TCP fallback for large responses or reduce EDNS0 UDP size. Also increase node-local-dns cache TTL to reduce upstream QPS
Sam Ortiz: practical command we ran on staging CoreDNS config:
```
# corefile snippet
.:53 {
    forward . 10.3.0.10 {
        policy sequential
        max_fails 3
    }
    edns0 512
}
```
Raj Patel: after setting edns0 512 and restarting node-local-dns on a few nodes, errors dropped from ~120/min to ~10/min for that service within 5m
Kelsey Nguyen: long term we need to standardize MTU across GPU and non-GPU subnets, or ensure routers preserve jumbo frames. Also review SR-IOV/RDMA CNI settings — some NICs bypass host stack and can cause path differences
Mia Chen: opened infra ticket INFRA-2241 to schedule maintenance window to align MTU and run end-to-end tests. Also adding monitoring rule: alert when node-local-dns upstream timeouts >5% for 1m
Sam Ortiz: other ideas: increase CoreDNS replica count on eu-west-1 for capacity, and add a small TCP fallback for critical svc lookups in client libraries (we can force 'resolver' to use TCP if UDP fails)
Raj Patel: thanks all — rolling patch to edns0 + restart applied cluster-wide as hotfix. We'll keep tickets for MTU remediation and confirm with packet captures after maintenance. :thumbsup:
